title: Flexibility and rigidity of steady states of the two-dimensional Euler equations in an infinite channel
summary: We study steady solutions to the two-dimensional incompressible Euler equations in an infinite channel, whose far-field limits are uniformly non-stagnant shear flows. In the smooth category,for a broad class of prescribed far-field shear profiles, non-shear steady states exist via the construction of two-dimensional solutions of the semilinear elliptic equations of stream function by the min--max method.
